@skipAuth.summary: Marks a field, object, or interface as exempt from Hive Gateway generic-auth complete protection.

authors.intro: Import from `https://specs.graphql-mesh.dev/auth/v0.1` (not core). Use with Federation `@authenticated` / `@requiresScopes` / `@policy` as needed. Requires Gateway generic auth in complete-protection mode.

implementers.runtime: Generic auth plugin skips auth checks for annotated fields/types when complete protection is enabled. No arguments.
